info.name: Interop Resolution Service
info.description: Every scenario of POST /v1/interop/resolve against the DEV profile (in-process member lookup stub on port 9090; start the service with --spring.profiles.active=DEV, the default profile is PQA). Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner; each request carries its own tests. Every memberId.forVendors entry carries the payerId and payerName Onyx puts on that vendor's request: the vendor's own for the member's company when configured, else the default, Point32Health. Every request identifies the caller: clientId (collection variable, ONYX), clientType (EXT, or INT for an internal caller) and a requestId unique per call, generated by the collection's pre-request script and echoed in every response. The answer carries the member id in every configured vendor's format (memberId.forVendors); Onyx sends each vendor its entry. One member lookup call per request. The member id is sent to the member lookup exactly as the EMR typed it (surrounding whitespace removed); the only check on it is presence. Besides those three, only the member id is required; unknown properties, a vendor included, are ignored. A sent date is the date judged: an unusable one is a 400, never replaced by today. Every 200 carries a one-sentence "message" right after "outcome". The member lookup's contract has four answers: 200 success, 404 member not found, 400 bad request, 500 internal error. This service maps them one to one: outcome from the records; 200 NOT_FOUND; 400 MEMBER_LOOKUP_REJECTED with the member lookup's text; 503 MEMBER_LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE. Only an unknown route of this service is a 404 from this service. On NOT_FOUND, "sourceMessage" (type, status, code, text) carries the member lookup's own message when the member lookup sent one.

item.name: 5 Member lookup failures (stub fault ids)
item.description: The member lookup's contract has four answers: 200 success, 404 member not found, 400 bad request, 500 internal error. This service maps them one to one: outcome from the records; 200 NOT_FOUND; 400 MEMBER_LOOKUP_REJECTED with the member lookup's text; 503 MEMBER_LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE. Only an unknown route of this service is a 404 from this service. Anything else from the member lookup endpoint (a gateway or proxy answering, not the member lookup) is 503 for 5xx / 429 / 408 and 502 otherwise; a connection failure or read timeout is 503; a 2xx body this service cannot read is 502 MEMBER_LOOKUP_INVALID_RESPONSE. The stub's reserved ids drive these answers: 500500500 (the member lookup 500), 503503503 (read timeout), 400400400 (the member lookup 400), 888888888 (200 with an error-typed message and no members), 202202202 (unreadable body), 887777777 (error message beside a member), 886666666 (record without a member id), 880000000 (only span unreadable). Any id the stub does not know is the member lookup's 404: 200 NOT_FOUND.
